automationExecutorHint: Rules run from real events or Cron. NOTIFY with recipients_rule OWNER saves an inbox notification. ADD_REPORT_ENTRY with section completed or uncompleted adds actual work facts to an editable member report draft. Current creator permission and source facts are rechecked; other actions explicitly fail as unsupported. SET_FIELD supports iteration, version and milestone with an ID value or an empty value to clear; locked versions and closed iterations remain protected. TRANSITION resolves to_state_key through the current workflow and supports DRAFT, READY and BLOCKED only when current readiness facts produce that state; paused or claimed work and acceptance remain protected. Work-linked review_sheet.closed triggers resolve the stored review target; requirement-only reviews do not invent a work item. REQUEST_VERIFICATION supports stage AUTOMATED, AGENT_TEST or AGENT_ACCEPTANCE through the existing frozen verification pipeline. It rechecks verification_run permission and reviewer locks, requests actual pending tasks and never supplies a verdict. SET_FIELD also supports risk and autonomy_level (LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH), and estimate_minutes (15–4800, or an empty value to clear). These edits recheck readiness and preserve other preparation fields. test_run.recorded matches stored test runs and resolves work from the frozen plan case, including after the current case is edited. ASSIGN with principal_id uses current assignment authority and eligible membership, and writes as SYSTEM; it creates no dispatch proposal or execution. DISPATCH_TO_AGENT with role EXECUTOR creates a real frozen dispatch proposal; MANUAL remains proposal-only, while AUTO applies only when the existing policy and current eligibility guards allow it. CREATE_LINKED_ITEM with type and title_template creates an unconfirmed linked DRAFT using the source objective and criteria; {title} and {number} expand source facts. No contract confirmation or execution is fabricated. Startup-registered SYSTEM action authority and current creator authority are both required.

clientHumanOverride: Human override: review the original result, reason and risk
testReportFrozen: Freeze the current results of 1–15 plans into an immutable PDF. Later runs do not change this report.
testReportPlans: Plan IDs (1–15, separated by commas or spaces)
testReportFailed: PDF generation failed. Create a new report to try again.
testReportPending: PDF generation pending. Refresh to check progress.
testFailureCreateDefect: Create a defect atomically with this failed run
clientFrozenPlan: This plan preserves the selected test-case versions. Runs are manual observations.
clientDownloadToView: Download this file to view its content.
delegationHint: Bounded authority for Agent reviewers. Revocation removes the IAM carrier bindings immediately.
delegationFixedConditions: Required verifications must pass. High risk and Human-required decisions are excluded. Escalation and project gates apply to every decision.
delegationDecisionUnavailable: Automatic delegated decisions are unavailable until current escalation evaluation and decision integration are connected.
delegationGrantHint: Grant only the actions you hold directly. A current Human reauthentication is required. Replacement atomically ends the previous grant.
delegationInvalid: Check IDs, actions, cost and risk. Merge grants require LOW risk.
delegationRevokeHint: Removing these bindings prevents further use of this delegation. Historical decisions remain unchanged.
delegationScheduleHint: Leave start empty to grant now. A future delegation takes effect after current eligibility is checked, within about 30 seconds of its start. It reserves this Agent's project slot and can be cancelled beforehand.
qualityRuleHint: Human-authored draft. Recording learning sends the rule to Knowledge review; a separate approval activates it.
packageImmutableReceipt: This receipt is immutable and bound to the exact published content.
packageLegacyReceipt: This legacy whole-package receipt has no structured item outcomes.
intakeNewProjectNotice: Create a new project and draft requirement from this exact assessment. Fresh identity verification is required.
packageConfirmed: I confirm the acceptance results above
packageItemNotice: Choose an outcome for every item. Rejected items require a category and a comment of at least 10 Unicode characters.
packageItemInvalid: Choose every outcome and provide a reason. Each rejection needs a category and a comment of 10-2000 Unicode characters.
packageReworkNotice: Read or retry the source derived from the immutable rejected receipt. This does not reopen work or apply scope changes.
packageReworkMismatch: The returned source does not match this project, package and content.
workbenchMachineLoadHint: Current slot reservations, including offline machines.
intakeWorkbenchDescription: Original requests, processing state and immutable triage sources.
intakeWorkbenchUnavailable: Some Intake conversion modes are not available yet.
clarificationInApp: Read and answer questions here in the app. Configured signed webhooks send event metadata only; email delivery is not connected.
intakeDelegatedNotice: Only a currently delegated Agent in an autonomous project can convert this frozen card into a draft requirement. The card author cannot perform the conversion. Creating a project requires a Human.
intakeNewRequirementNotice: Creates a draft from this exact triage revision. Review, client signoff and work preparation follow separately. The title must fit 200 characters and there may be at most 50 criteria.
intakeTriageDraftOnly: This assessment is an internal draft. It does not sign a baseline or send questions to the client.
intakeTriageRetry: Your edits are preserved. Reload the source if its version has changed, then retry.
intakeWorkbenchEmpty: No Intake records in this project.
intakeWorkbenchNoCard: No frozen change triage card exists for this record.
spawnRequestsDescription: Review source-backed Agent requests. Human adoption uses existing registration. Autonomous creation is unavailable until its source command exists.
workAndonActive: Andon is active. Execution and downstream work are guarded.
workAndonHint: This hold preserves the work state. Clearing it does not restart a runner.
workAndonRuntimeUnavailable: Runner pause is unavailable. A saved hold does not confirm that an active runner has paused.
workAndonRuntimePending: Runtime controls require a runner acknowledgment. A saved hold alone does not confirm process suspension.
workAndonReceiptSnapshot: At command time (including replay); refresh execution detail for current runner state.
workAndonPauseAcknowledged: Runner acknowledged pause at command time.
workAndonNotRunning: No running process was reported at command time.
sourceDispositionReceipt_POSTED: Posted to the original client thread
sourceDispositionHint: Original source bytes and messages are preserved. Optional notices use the linked client-shared thread; without a link, transport remains unavailable.
workBoardColumnHint: Each column loads and pages independently. Drag or use Move to request a guarded domain action.
workBoardGuarded: This move requires another domain action or permission. Open work details to review readiness, assignment, execution or acceptance.
workBoardStale: The work changed. Refresh the board before moving it.
workBoardConfirmHint: The server rechecks current version, project state and permission. A move never bypasses readiness or acceptance.
workBoardUnchanged: Readiness was checked but the requested state was not reached. Review work details for blockers.
workBlock_ANDON: A Human Andon hold is active.
workBlock_ANDON_UPSTREAM: Andon on this work or an upstream dependency blocks progress.
upstreamHint: Consume exact accepted evidence from a direct predecessor. Changed or unavailable sources block downstream delivery; reconciliation never reruns work or rewrites historical decisions.
conversationRetractConfirm: Retracting removes this text from the conversation. Authorized auditors can still read its history.
conversationEditRules: Authors can edit text for 15 minutes, up to 10 times. Earlier text is retained for authorized audit.
agentWakeHelp: Wake hints contain no message content. Webhooks require a public HTTPS receiver that verifies the signature and rejects timestamps older than 300 seconds. Poll the inbox if a hint is missed.
agentWakeURL: Public HTTPS webhook URL (webhook mode only)
agentWakeSecretOnce: Save this signing secret now. It is shown only once. Configure the receiver to verify X-Wake-Signature using HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + "." + the raw request body.
scheduleEmpty: No work in this calendar range.
intakeConversationWorkHint: Optional: link this message to work for this source requirement. Your authority and the current work version are checked before posting.
intakeConversationForwardHint: Forward an actual client reply from this merged source to its current target thread. The original message stays unchanged; the forwarding message records its source. Both threads must be linked first.
intakeConversationHint: Link the actual client message matching this source. Questions, optional disposition notices and replies use this shared thread.
intakeSuggestionsHint: Suggestions preserve their author and source version. Review them before using the separate triage or conversion actions.
sourceDispositionNotify: Notify the client in the linked source thread
knowledgeEmbeddingRequirements: Embedding requires a configured model, vector storage and a working index worker. Hybrid indexing remains unavailable until these prerequisites are satisfied.
knowledgeSourceAgentRetired: The owning Agent has retired. This source is excluded from retrieval.
knowledgeUploadHint: Up to 10 UTF-8 Markdown, text or source-code files; 10 MiB per file. Extraction is limited to 2,000,000 characters and 2,000 chunks. PDF is unavailable.
agentManifestHint: Published contracts do not grant access. Capabilities use current permissions; missing resource or quota context is shown explicitly.
toolImportDisabled: Imports stay disabled until explicitly enabled. Enter verified configuration; machine observations contain names only.
modeNotice: Takeover revokes delegated authority and switches dispatch to manual. Running processes retain their execution state.
modeCriterion_P1: Reviewer approval delegation remains valid for at least 24 hours.
modeCriterion_P2: All required escalation rules are enabled.
modeCriterion_P4: An active project executor Agent exists.
modeCriterion_P5: The project stage permits autonomous work.
packageRecordedBy: Recorded by {recorder} on behalf of the client · evidence attached
packageOfflineNotice: Record the client’s actual decision for every frozen item. Attach the signed document or email screenshot from project Files. Fresh identity verification is required.
packageOfflineFileID: Evidence file ID from project Files
releaseNoteHelp: Requests use frozen package sources. Refresh after the Agent submits. Human final edits are required before adoption.
attentionActive: Attention counts only while this view is visible, focused and recently active.
attentionUnavailable: Attention measurement is unavailable; no time is inferred.
usedKnowledgeSourceChanged: The original content has changed. This is the frozen execution snapshot.
usedKnowledgeScoresUnavailable: Scores are temporarily unavailable; showing the frozen execution snapshot.
usedKnowledgeFallback: Hybrid search was unavailable; full-text search was used.
usedKnowledgeUnavailable: No automatic retrieval record is available for this execution.
usedKnowledgeRulesOmitted: Rules omitted by the rule budget
usedKnowledgeTruncated: The frozen reference was shortened to fit its token budget.
settingsLeadPrincipal: Lead principal ID (leave empty to keep; 0 clears)
settingsMemberRules: Active assignments must be reassigned first. The last delivery lead and explicit deny bindings cannot be removed.
agentRestartPolicy: Automatic restart waits 10 seconds, 1 minute, then 5 minutes. A fourth crash within 30 minutes stops automatic restart. A manual start or restart clears the counter.
knowledgeSkillDistillHint: Use the accepted delivery and passed verification to draft a reusable skill. A Human must review the resulting version before it can be mounted. Requests for this work item reuse the same execution for 24 hours.
knowledgeSkillDistillState_RUNNING: The Agent is generating a skill draft.
knowledgeSkillDistillState_DRAFT: The skill draft is ready for Human review.
knowledgeSkillDistillState_FAILED: Distillation did not produce a valid skill draft.
knowledgeNativeEmpty: No matching knowledge. Try fewer terms or remove a filter.
knowledgeEmbeddingHint: Requires PostgreSQL with pgvector and a configured provider allowlist. Replacing a credential requires fresh verification. Model changes backfill before cutover; unavailable services fall back to text search.
rosterStatisticsScope: Work and decisions visible to you. Rates need at least 5 first decisions.
pipelineSourceNotice: Rebuilt from recorded source facts. Missing stages do not imply success or a pending Human task. Both views show the current page only.
provenanceLimitations: Recorded evidence is not a verification verdict. Partial output requires review before reuse. Comparison matches kind, title and criterion; it does not merge files.
provenanceTruncated: This view is bounded. Missing comparison or verifier facts are unknown.
provenanceNoVerifier: No recorded platform verifier. No verified result is implied.
fleetInstallPrerequisites: Requires Node.js 24+, Git 2.30+ and an installed, signed-in Codex or Claude Code. Edit the profile path and machine name before login. Keep the daemon running after approval.
fleetInstall_login: 2. Log in and compare the displayed code
fleetCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the command manually.
fleetInstallerUnavailable: No published installer is configured. Ask the deployment administrator to configure the package, version, command, external server URL and tenant client.
fleetEnrollment_COMPLETE: Credential collected; start the machine program
fleetManualModelsHint: Up to 50 model IDs per runtime, one per line. Refreshes preserve manual entries. Listed models do not guarantee provider availability.
novelBoundary: Structured human-authored facts; deterministic checks are advisory and never authorize acceptance.
novelSemanticUnavailable: Semantic / LLM continuity checks unavailable. CED covers recorded fact contradictions only; no model verdict.
novelFactHint: Tick is story time; start is a zero-based Unicode character offset. The quotation must match the original exactly.
novelStaleEvidence: This citation belongs to an older version. The frozen quotation is shown separately from the current original.
novelStale: Report is stale; rerun the whole book
novelIssue_SAME_TIME_CONTRADICTION: Conflicting facts at the same story time
videoBoundary: Provider jobs and immutable artifact versions are source facts. Human notes and model advice never prove acceptance.
videoMediaBoundary: Original media preview; captions, full-frame quality and acceptance are not established by playback.
videoReported: Human-recorded material; no provider provenance asserted
videoReferenceHint: Pin actual Execution artifacts as character, costume, voice or licensed reference assets.
videoMasterHint: A master is a pinned artifact; final designation does not imply QC or client acceptance.
videoQCNotice: Actual platform rerun receipts, scoped to the displayed Execution/result version and commit. No receipt means unavailable; execution-level QC does not prove every clip or frame.
videoQCUnavailable: No authoritative automated QC receipt is recorded.
videoProviderHint: Configured is not a live health guarantee. Missing adapters or credentials remain unavailable. Provider changes affect future jobs; historical provenance stays pinned.
packageBundleHint: Publishing requires a current bundle. Changes to evidence, acceptance, release notes or portal settings require a new build. If a portal policy changes contributor labels, edit and save the selected evidence before rebuilding.
fleetEnrollmentCodeHint: Enter the eight-character code displayed by the machine. Closing this page does not cancel enrollment.
fleetEnrollmentReported: Reported by this device. Compare these details before approving; runtime availability is checked again after connection.
fleetEnrollmentWaiting: Waiting for the machine to collect its credential…
fleetEnrollmentWaitingOnline: Waiting for the machine program to connect. Run the start command on that machine.
fleetEnrollmentDelayed: The machine has been offline for ten minutes. Check its network and start command, or open machine details.
fleetPricesHint: USD micros per million tokens. Enter exact whole numbers. Missing prices are unknown; an explicit zero means free. Prices apply across machines in this tenant.
fleetDeletePriceConfirm: Remove this price? Future usage without a reported cost will have an unknown price.
fleetHostedAgentsHint: Current Agents bound to this machine, including their lifecycle and process status.
fleetExecutionHistoryHint: Actual executions on this machine, including completed records. Only currently authorized projects are shown. Continue to the next page if a scan contains no visible records.
fleetHistoryNoAccess: Agent directory permission is required to view hosted Agents.
fleetNoHostedAgents: No Agents are currently bound to this machine.
fleetNoExecutionHistory: No visible execution records on this page.
operatingPlatformSingleAdminDescription: This deployment uses one operational administration. Additional operating platform creation is disabled; existing spaces, members and permissions are preserved.
